scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Two years college-level coursework or equivalent with work in business administration, human resources management, or a related field. EXPERIENCE: Minimum one year of general office experience working within complex technical responsibilities. (Technical area to which assigned and educational setting preferred.) Please visit Human Resources Technician (Download PDF reader) to view the complete job description.

items.item_text: 01. I understand that with advanced notice I may be required to be flexible with my substitute assignment work schedule. Options: Yes, I understand and accept this work condition. | No, I do not accept and cannot adhere to this work condition.

02. I understand the duration of the substitute assignment is for three (3) months but may be extended. Options: Yes, I understand and accept this work condition | No, I do not accept and cannot adhere to this work condition.

03. The following supplemental questions will help us determine if you meet the minimum qualification standards for this position. Additionally, the information provided in the answers to these questions will be considered if a scored evaluation of your training and experience is utilized during the assessment process. Respond honestly and truthfully to all questions. Over-evaluating your experience or skill level is considered providing false and/or misleading information. Applicants found to have provided false or misleading information of their skills or experience will be disqualified from further employment processing, or if hired, immediately terminated from employment. Experience listed below must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. I acknowledge that I have read and understand the above statement. Options: Yes | No

04. What is your highest level of education completed? Please Note: If hired, proof of education will be required during onboarding. Options: High School Diploma or G.E.D. Equivalent | Some College | Associate's Degree | Bachelor's Degree | Master's Degree | Doctorate | None of the Above

05. If you have indicated a degree above, please state the area of concentration for your degree. If you have multiple degrees, please list all areas of concentration. If you did not indicate a degree, please answer N/A.

06. How many years of full-time, paid, progressively responsible do you have related to general office experience working with complex technical responsibilities? Your related work experience must be clearly shown in the areas for work history on your application. Options: I do not have any related work experience. | I have been trained in this area but have no related work experience. | I have less than 1 year of related work experience | I have more than 1 year but less than 2 years of related work experience. | I have more than 2 years but less than 4 years of related work experience. | I have more than 4 years but less than 6 years of related work experience. | I have more than 6 years but less than 8 years of related work experience. | I have more than 8 years but less than 10 years of related work experience. | I have more than 10 years of related work experience.

07. Please describe the experience you have indicated above regarding experience related to general office experience working with complex technical responsibilities. Be sure to include the following, in the format presented: EMPLOYER: JOB TITLE: NUMBER OF HOURS WORKED PER WEEK: SPECIFIC DUTIES PERFORMED RELATED TO EXPERIENCE RELATED TO GENRAL OFFICE EXPERIENCE WORKING WITH COMPLEX TECHNICAL RESPONSIBILITIES: The experience listed must be represented in the work history section of your application. A resume may be attached, but not substituted for completing the work history, education sections, or the supplemental questions of the employment application. Providing incomplete responses or answering "See Resume" or "See Application" or generic answers such as "I have many years of experience" which do not adequately address the specific content of the question may automatically disqualify your application from further consideration. If you have no experience, please answer N/A.
